document: Deutscher Bundestag, Datenhandbuch zur Geschichte des Deutschen Bundestages, Kapitel 1.1 Wahlgesetze und Wahlrechtsregelungen (Stand 31.3.2022)
rule: Facts only: official law titles, the dates the Bundestag adopted (verabschiedet) and promulgated (verkündet) each law, the Federal Law Gazette reference, and a summary of the changes in the Atlas's own words. The chapter's text is not reproduced (bundestag.de terms: private use). The chapter prints no entry-into-force dates; none are asserted.

date_fields.in_force: not printed in the source; not asserted

laws.title: Neuntes Gesetz zur Änderung des Bundeswahlgesetzes
laws.summary_en: Berlin's members to be elected directly for the 12th Bundestag (ending their election by the Berlin House of Representatives); eight Berlin constituencies added; transitional provisions; amends § 53.
laws.summary_zh: 第12届联邦议院起柏林议员改为直选（不再由柏林众议院选出）；增设8个柏林选区；过渡性规定；修订第53条。

laws.title: Gesetz zu dem Vertrag vom 3. August 1990 zur Vorbereitung und Durchführung der ersten gesamtdeutschen Wahl des Deutschen Bundestages zwischen der Bundesrepublik Deutschland und der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik
laws.summary_en: Ratifies the election treaty signed on 3 August 1990: federal electoral law extended to the GDR Länder; Bundestag members raised from 518 to 656; constituencies 257–328 added for Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Brandenburg, Sachsen-Anhalt, Sachsen, Thüringen and East Berlin; list associations of different parties admitted for the first all-German election; Berlin treated as one Land; shortened deadlines.
laws.summary_zh: 批准1990年8月3日签署的选举条约：联邦选举法扩展适用于民主德国各州；联邦议院议员由518名增至656名；为梅克伦堡-前波莫瑞、勃兰登堡、萨克森-安哈尔特、萨克森、图林根及东柏林增设第257–328号选区；首次全德选举允许不同政党的名单联合；柏林作为一个州对待；缩短期限。

laws.title: Zehntes Gesetz zur Änderung des Bundeswahlgesetzes sowie zur Änderung des Parteiengesetzes
laws.summary_en: Adapts the electoral law for the 12th Bundestag to the Federal Constitutional Court's judgment of 29 September 1990: the threshold is applied to two separate electoral areas (the territories of the two German states before 3 October 1990); list associations admitted for parties and other political associations seated in the former GDR; amends § 53 of the Federal Electoral Act.
laws.summary_zh: 依联邦宪法法院1990年9月29日判决调整第12届联邦议院选举法：门槛分别适用于两个选举区域（1990年10月3日前两个德国国家的领土）；允许总部位于前民主德国的政党及其他政治团体组成名单联合；修订《联邦选举法》第53条。

laws.title: Elftes Gesetz zur Änderung des Bundeswahlgesetzes
laws.summary_en: New division and description of the constituencies; constituency boundaries to change only by federal law even when Land borders change; public deliberation of the Federal Electoral Committee on party recognition.
laws.summary_zh: 重新划分并描述选区；即使州界变动，选区边界也只能由联邦法律变更；联邦选举委员会公开审议政党资格认定。

laws.title: Zwölftes Gesetz zur Änderung des Bundeswahlgesetzes
laws.summary_en: Moves one residential area from constituency 282 (Brandenburg) to constituency 288 (Sachsen-Anhalt) after a Land border change.
laws.summary_zh: 因州界变动，将一处居民区由第282选区（勃兰登堡）划入第288选区（萨克森-安哈尔特）。

laws.title: Dreizehntes Gesetz zur Änderung des Bundeswahlgesetzes
laws.summary_en: Reduces the Bundestag to 598 members from the 15th electoral term (so not for the 1998 election); changes to constituency boundaries for the 14th Bundestag.
laws.summary_zh: 自第15届起将联邦议院减至598名议员（不适用于1998年选举）；调整第14届联邦议院的选区划分。

laws.title: Vierzehntes Gesetz zur Änderung des Bundeswahlgesetzes
laws.summary_en: Voting rights for Germans abroad: a three-month uninterrupted stay in the federal territory at any time suffices.
laws.summary_zh: 海外德国人投票权：曾在联邦境内连续居住三个月即可。

rejected_proposals.summary_en: Proposal to regionalise the 5% clause again (as in 1990) and lower it to 3% for the 13th Bundestag; rejected in second reading on 1994-01-20. The 1994 election therefore used one national threshold.
rejected_proposals.summary_zh: 关于第13届联邦议院再次按区域适用5%条款（如1990年）并降至3%的提案，于1994年1月20日二读时被否决。因此1994年选举适用全国统一门槛。

rejected_proposals.summary_en: Proposal to offset overhang seats within the same party's other Land lists for the 14th Bundestag; rejected in second reading on 1996-10-11. Overhang seats in 1998 were not compensated.
rejected_proposals.summary_zh: 关于第14届联邦议院在同一政党其他州名单中抵消超额席位的提案，于1996年10月11日二读时被否决。1998年超额席位未获补偿。
